## Activity

During April 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 58 captures. This was the activity submitted for review during the month and provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total is reported for the site as part of routine monthly monitoring. It supports comparison of service activity with the findings from image assessment and grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 2 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.4 per cent of captures. This result identifies the proportion of submitted images that could not be used for grading. The image-quality finding should be considered alongside the grading results when reviewing the service’s overall performance for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 20 days. This measure indicates the typical time taken for review and provides an assessment of grading timeliness. The referable results and median lag together summarise the grading activity reported for Hill Counties Health Centre during April 2022.
